About this item

  • Versatile Lighting Options: This LED desk lamp offers 25 light combination modes with 5 color temperatures (3000K-5500K) and 5 brightness levels (20%-100%), along with night light and reading modes, catering to various lighting needs.
  • Adjustable Design for Optimal Lighting: With a 360° standing, 180° foldable swing arms, and a 270° rotatable lamp head, this lamp can be adjusted to any angle, ensuring suitable lighting coverage for workspaces, reading, studying, drawing, sewing, and crafting.
  • Wireless Remote Control: Equipped with a wireless smart remote control, this lamp allows you to easily switch between modes and brightness levels, providing a convenient and portable lighting experience.
  • Energy-Efficient and Eye-Friendly: Featuring LED technology, this desk lamp offers even illumination without glare, flicker, or blue light hazard, reducing eye strain and promoting a comfortable working environment.
  • Note: If your remote control isn't working, for a free replacement—no return needed.

  • Can the brightness of this desk lamp be adjusted? How many modes are there?

    Yes. You can adjust the lights by its smart control. This LED desk lamp has 25 modes [5 different color (3000K all the way to 5500K) X 5 Brightness levels (20% to 100%)] and you can choose your favorite color temperature and brightness.

  • When the desk lamp is fully extended, what is the range of illumination?

    Well, combination of 2 lights fully extends stem length to 31.5 inches, lighting range up to 71 inches, evenly covers a wider area of the desktop with brighter light.

  • Can the lamp arm of this desk lamp be freely rotated back and forth?

    The swing arm of the desk lamp can be freely rotated at 360°, and the light bar can also be rotated freely at 270° front and back, allowing you to turn the desk lamp at any angle

  • Will there be ghosting and glare on the display if the light is placed above the computer?

    This LED desk lamp is evenly illuminated, with no glare, no flicker, and no blue light hazard. You can completely trust it.

  • Is this Led head led desk lamp easy to install? what is the maximum thickness of the table that this clip can hold?

    Easy to install, flexible adjustable clip design, maximum desk thickness 2.5 inches.

    Amazon Customer
    5 out of 5 stars
    Worth every penny and then some!!
    Only 1 regret related to this purchase; that I waited this long to finally add a lamp to my makeshift “office” at home and subsequently finding this lamp. For years I’ve worked under an overhead light in my dining room (I own a townhouse, not huge so no extra room for an actual office, therefore my desk is downstairs in between the LR and DR) with my headaches and migraines becoming more and more frequent. I set the lamp up almost immediately upon delivery. Super simple to set up, no hassle at all, clamp it to the desk, tighten the clamp, plug it up and throw 2 AAA’s into the remote and BAM! You’re done. The strain on my eyes and my head was almost instantly relieved. The numerous light settings to choose from, AWESOMENESS. After trying them all I finally found my sweet spot (and It took less than five minutes to find). I love that it has a nightlight setting (didn’t notice that in the description) and a timer. It appears to be made very well, very sturdy but easily flexed to your liking. Love that the lights are two different bars and can be adjusted individually as well. Overall, best money I’ve spent on my workspace since I discovered the almighty mouse jiggler, honestly. If you’re on the fence and looking at every lamp Amazon has listed, save your time and energy and just click to buy, I promise, you won’t be disappointed!!

      I LOVE this thing! I'm an online college student, so I use my computer desk for all my learning. This light is super nice. The max brightness is VERY bright - it lights up my entire workspace. The other settings are great for low light/late night use. I also really enjoy the touch power on/off remote it comes with. Very easy to power on/off or choose my light setting. I also like that I can adjust the direction and angle of the light bars quickly and easily.

      Setting it up only took 1-2 minutes, and it's securely fastened to my desk. Even when I need to adjust the gooseneck or the light bars, it's sturdy. I've never had any issues with the lights, and I've been running them almost 8-10hrs a day for the last 5 months straight.

      Overall, probably one of my better purchases this year. I'm not a "big light" kind of person, so this is perfect for when I want darkness but still need to do my math homework, haha.

I set the lamp up almost immediately upon delivery. Super simple to set up, no hassle at all, clamp it to the desk, tighten the clamp, plug it up and throw 2 AAA’s into the remote and BAM! You’re done. The strain on my eyes and my head was almost instantly relieved. The numerous light settings to choose from, AWESOMENESS. After trying them all I finally found my sweet spot (and It took less than five minutes to find). I love that it has a nightlight setting (didn’t notice that in the description) and a timer. It appears to be made very well, very sturdy but easily flexed to your liking. Love that the lights are two different bars and can be adjusted individually as well. Overall, best money I’ve spent on my workspace since I discovered the almighty mouse jiggler, honestly. If you’re on the fence and looking at every lamp Amazon has listed, save your time and energy and just click to buy, I promise, you won’t be disappointed!!

      I needed a desk lamp that could work with two 27-inch monitors in a fairly dim room. While this doesn't stretch all the way across both screens, it covers the center area toward 3/4 of the each monitors comfortably, which is more than enough for what I need. The brightness levels are great and make it easy to switch from screen work to writing or handling small parts on the desk without needing extra light.

      The gooseneck holds its position well once adjusted, and the remote is surprisingly responsive and handy. The build feels solid and I haven’t had any issues with it drifting or sagging. The various color temperature settings also help a lot depending on the time of day.

      If you're not looking for something that eliminates every shadow like a photography setup, this light does the job for 99% of daily work needs. Definitely a solid buy for any home office or study space.

      I think this is a great product. I needed something for work that helped ease my eye strain due to light sensitivity. When searching for a monitor light I saw that there were many less expensive options available, however I went with this one because of the reviews and multiple settings (4-5 brightness levels, yellow lighting or bright lighting, timer, etc.). It is working great so far and I am really impressed.

      I really appreciate the very easy and functional touch settings pad that is battery operated and not attached to the light fixture itself. This allows me to keep it close by and adjust the settings when necessary. I also really like that the lights tilt so I can have them directly projecting onto my screen or I can turn them around to bounce off my cubicle wall, allowing for a more soft overhead light.

      I recently purchased a different model from a computer store that was on sale for $17 (single light, not double like this one) for my home computer, and it just does not compare. It feels cheaper and does not come with the same settings as this one. I have learned to buy quality items that I will only have to buy once versus less expensive items that require replacing more often. This light feels heavy duty and does an amazing job.

    About this Item

    • Versatile Lighting Options: This LED desk lamp offers 25 light combination modes with 5 color temperatures (3000K-5500K) and 5 brightness levels (20%-100%), along with night light and reading modes, catering to various lighting needs.
    • Adjustable Design for Optimal Lighting: With a 360° standing, 180° foldable swing arms, and a 270° rotatable lamp head, this lamp can be adjusted to any angle, ensuring suitable lighting coverage for workspaces, reading, studying, drawing, sewing, and crafting.
    • Wireless Remote Control: Equipped with a wireless smart remote control, this lamp allows you to easily switch between modes and brightness levels, providing a convenient and portable lighting experience.
    • Energy-Efficient and Eye-Friendly: Featuring LED technology, this desk lamp offers even illumination without glare, flicker, or blue light hazard, reducing eye strain and promoting a comfortable working environment.
    • Note: If your remote control isn't working, for a free replacement—no return needed.

    Product Description

    "

    This double-headed LED desk lamp from Pzloz is a perfect combination of modern style and functional diversity. It is an excellent choice for your office or home.

    Our desk lamp is made of high-quality aluminum alloy with smooth and matte surface, stylish and durable, looks high-end modern and textured.

    It is equipped with a wireless smart remote control with 5 levels of brightness and 5 levels of color temperature, which can realize 25 light combination modes, you can easily adjust the light to meet your needs.

    The desk lamp adopts a double lamp head design, 360° standing and 180° foldable swing arm allow you to turn the desk lamp at any angle to provide you with the most suitable lighting range.

    Uniform lighting, no glare, no flicker, no blue light hazards, can relieve eye fatigue caused by looking at computer screens for a long time, thus protecting our eyes.

    Ideal for large workbenches, task, drafting and architect's desks with wide curved or dual monitors, this desk lamp gives you a well-lit environment for working, reading, studying, drawing, sewing and crafting.
